_readme: Documentation-only config for the opt-in Ariel Hernandez swing-trader match filter (Phase 4, docs/index.html, PR #226 merged 2026-07-01). Unlike selector_versions.json and display_methodology.json, this file is NOT anti-drift-guarded by any test -- there is no test_ariel_match_config.py, and no CI check compares these values to the live ARIEL_* JS constants. This is a deliberate scope decision: Ariel-match is an optional, additive display layer independent of the core All/Focus methodology (it filters displayRows further, in both views, but does not change base_filter/focus_dq/focus_score), so it does not need the same guarantee of replay determinism. Enforcement is manual code review only -- if you change an ARIEL_* constant in docs/index.html, update this file's 'current' entry in the same PR as a courtesy, but nothing will fail CI if you forget. If replay/A-B testing of Ariel-match ever becomes a real requirement, promote this to a guarded file (data/picks/display_methodology.json pattern) at that time.

versions.description: Initial Ariel Hernandez swing-trader match filter (Phase 4). Four independent gates -- group leadership, liquidity, daily-move band, growth -- combined into an overall 'full' | 'soft' | null tier. Dollar volume is a hard boolean (no soft band); the other three gates each have a soft-qualify band. Overall tier is the weakest of the three soft-able gates.

group_gate.formula: sum = rank_month + rank_quarter (ascending, computed across all ~144 industries in state.data.industries.delta, not limited to groups picks.csv has stock rows for); pos = 1-indexed rank by sum, lower sum = stronger group

liquidity_gate.formula: Price * Avg Volume (same parsing as the Focus liquidity gate in display_methodology.json v2)
liquidity_gate.note: Hard floor, no soft band -- this is a liquidity floor (can you actually trade it), not a strength signal. NaN -> fails.

daily_move_gate.note: Outside [floor_soft, ceil_soft] -> excluded entirely (too quiet or too volatile). Inside [full_low, full_high] -> full. Otherwise (in a soft band on either side) -> soft.

growth_gate.logic: AND -- both metrics must independently clear the same threshold
growth_gate.note: Both metrics >= 25% -> full. Both >= 15% (and not both >= 25%) -> soft. Either metric < 15% -> fails the growth gate outright.

overall_tier.formula: weakest of {group_gate, daily_move_gate, growth_gate} tiers, AND liquidity_gate must pass (hard boolean)
overall_tier.note: 'full' only if all three soft-able gates are full AND liquidity passes. 'soft' if all three are at least soft (some may be full) AND liquidity passes. Otherwise null (no match).
